ios-content|Text views.summary: On iOS the Plenix rich-text editor is the system text view, kept native in behavior (selection handles, the edit menu with its Format items, Dynamic Type, dictation, VoiceOver reading and editing the text): an attributed-text view whose allowed formats are the Plenix ones (bold, italic, links, lists), framed like a Plenix field: the control surface, the control border that takes the focus color while editing, and the 6-point control corners. The text is DM Sans at the body size. The formatting bar sits above the keyboard (an input accessory view) with the Plenix toolbar buttons, each showing whether the text at the caret has its format. Read-only is the same view, not editable, on the sunken surface.

anatomy.name: Frame
anatomy.about: The field frame: the control surface, the control border (the focus color while editing) and the control corners.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.about: The attributed text in DM Sans at the body size, with the Plenix formats only: bold, italic, links in the link color, lists.

anatomy.name: Formatting bar
anatomy.about: The Plenix toolbar buttons above the keyboard; a format that is on at the caret shows the selected state.

anatomy.name: Placeholder
anatomy.about: The hint in the empty view, in the subtle content color.

swiftui: /// The Plenix rich-text editor on iOS: the system text editor with attributed text, framed like a Plenix field (PlenixTokens.swift).
uikit: /// The Plenix rich-text editor on iOS: a UITextView with attributed text and a formatting bar above the keyboard (PlenixTokens.swift).
font = UIFontMetrics(forTextStyle: .body).scaledFont(for: UIFont(name: Plenix.Font.sans, size: Plenix.Platform.textBodySize)!)
textContainerInset = UIEdgeInsets(top: Plenix.Space.spaceInsetSm, left: Plenix.Space.spaceInsetMd, bottom: Plenix.Space.spaceInsetSm, right: Plenix.Space.spaceInsetMd)
required init?(coder: NSCoder) { fatalError("init(coder:) is not supported") }
func textViewDidBeginEditing(_ textView: UITextView) { layer.borderColor = Plenix.Colors.focusRingColor.cgColor }
func textViewDidEndEditing(_ textView: UITextView) { layer.borderColor = Plenix.Colors.controlBorder.cgColor }
